oracle_recommendation.name: pycrate
oracle_recommendation.basis: Existing full-PDU/N11 qualification pins pycrate 0.7.11 and compiles all six frozen NGAP modules. This is a recommendation, not yet frozen for M6.003.

schema_authority.equivalence_method: Require exact module order, Git blob IDs and SHA-256 values for the six frozen source files; compile the unmodified six module texts into pycrate in the dedicated venv. Compare those same identities against the ASN.1 source authority used for the generated headers.

approved_deviations.policy: Strict inherited native SDK zero-padding check

recommendation_only.ordering: Accept ASN.1-valid IE order on receive; retain exact order; emit the approved canonical order on local encode.
recommendation_only.duplicates: Reject duplicate singleton ProtocolIE/ProtocolExtension identities as invalid_transfer; generated collection codec itself still represents repeated entries.
recommendation_only.known_criticality_mismatch: Reject as invalid_transfer before semantic projection.
recommendation_only.unknown_ie_or_extension: For criticality=reject, reject as invalid_transfer. For criticality=ignore, structurally validate, retain raw identity/order/payload, and ignore only after the R1 adapter has established the field is semantically safe. For criticality=notify, reject as unsupported_profile until an approved Error Indication action exists. Unknown SEQUENCE additions have no IE criticality; retain their opaque payload and allow only the explicitly approved ignore behavior.
recommendation_only.known_non_r1_optional_fields: Do not discard fields that can affect R1 meaning; retain metadata and return unsupported_profile without success/event. In particular additional DL tunnel/failed-flow lists are outside the Setup Response R1 projection.

native_error_mapping.invalid_argument: local argument error; do not translate to malformed wire
native_error_mapping.invalid_state_or_unexpected_exception: internal error; propagate and never convert to success

groups: oracle minimum legal vector per root
representative optional fields, CHOICE arms, IPv4 address widths and nonzero TEID edges
D2 ARP labels and exact bit-rate boundaries
oracle encode -> native decode -> field-by-field semantic assertions
native encode -> independent pycrate decode -> field-by-field semantic assertions
canonical APER byte equality for explicitly frozen vectors only
IE/extension order, duplicate, unknown payload and criticality capability versus AMF/Simulator receive policy
oracle-seeded mutations: truncation, trailing octet, nonzero padding, malformed length/choice/constraint
4096 input acceptance boundary, 4097 valid input resource_limit, output cap boundary and over-cap non-publication
coverage_plan.qualification_claim: No pass is recorded until the Owner-frozen receive/error policy is supplied and the terminal runner executes.
